## Routing Decisions — Chapter 5B (Economic Wellbeing)

| chunk_id | Decision | Relevant Question IDs | Lenses Cited | Adjacent Context Needed | Exclusion Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| U0001 | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Establishes subject identity and mandate dates (2018–2024) as factual anchor. | Pure navigation, metadata, and biographical header. No economic policy content. |
| U0002 | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Contextualises pre-2018 political trajectory; "intenso calado social" in DF administration is background. | General political narrative, electoral history, partisan positioning. No concrete economic policy actions, outcomes, costs, or distributional findings. |
| U0003 | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Establishes 2006 and 2012 electoral challenges and the "Coalición por el Bien de Todos" framing. | Dispute over election results and broad political programme description. No specific fiscal, tax, monetary, competition, or budget execution content. |
| U0004 | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Documents opposition to Peña Nieto's reforms (energética, educativa, laboral, telecomunicaciones). | Political hostility described; reform content named but not analysed for economic quality. No measured outcomes, implementation findings, or distributional results. Generic disapproval, not evidence of economic management quality. |
| U0005 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.6, 5B.8, 5B.10 | 1, 3, 6, 8, 10 | U0004 provides the opposition context that frames why these 2018 promises were framed as corrective. U0006 provides the governing-style overlay and early-month policy signals. | **Concrete policy content:** "austeridad republicana" to reorient public resources from operating to investment without tax increases; poverty combat and human development for vulnerable groups; increase domestic gasoline output to reduce imports and lower prices; energy and food self-sufficiency with guaranteed prices for local producers; eradication of political corruption "giving example" from Los Pinos. These are named policy actions with implied distributional intent (5B.8 — vulnerable groups) and trajectory claims (5B.10 — reversing prior policies). |
| U0006 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.2, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.7, 5B.10 | 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 10 | U0005 provides the specific policy promises to which 5B.1/5B.10 evaluative language in U0006 responds. | **Concrete policy content:** platform described as "socialdemocracia pragmática" assuming orthodox free-market notions, macroeconomic stability, budget discipline, peso floatation — explicit alignment with credible fiscal/monetary rules (5B.3); rejection of privatising and "extranjerización" of strategic sectors, priority for national production (5B.4); promise to investigate former presidents for corruption without vengeance, signalling anti-corruption enforcement posture (5B.5 weak); "Consulta Nacional Ciudadana" on priority programmes — evidence of citizen consultation mechanism (5B.7); promises not to betray the people while respecting legal order — governing legitimacy claim (5B.1); "Cuarta Transformación" framing and creation of Guardia Nacional (security, not directly economic). |
| U0007 | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Provides migration and trade context (USMCA, caravanas, Trump border threats) relevant to external economic conditions during early term. | Geopolitical and migration context. No specific domestic economic policy action, outcome, or distributional finding. Trade deal characterisation ("beneficial") is an assertion without measured evidence. |
| U0008 | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Establishes early biographical and family context. | Biographical narrative of childhood, family tragedy, relocation. No economic policy content. |
| U0009 | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Documents entry into PRI machine politics, early postings in state government and indigenous promotion. | Career trajectory through party structures and early administrative postings. No specific economic policy, rule, budget, or distributional content. |
| U0010 | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Documents rise within Tabasco PRI under González Pedrero, director of CEPES, head of Tabasco PRI. | Party and electoral career narrative. No specific economic governance content. Background for understanding political formation only. |

---

**Summary: 2 included, 8 excluded.**

**Included chunks and their 5B lens coverage:**

- **U0005** (lenses 1, 3, 6, 8, 10): Named policy pledges with directional economic intent — austerity reallocation, poverty/HDI focus, import-substitution energy, guaranteed prices for agriculture, anti-corruption framing. Implies distributional targeting (5B.8) and trajectory change (5B.10).
- **U0006** (lenses 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 10): Explicit adoption of orthodox macroeconomic framework alongside nationalist productive protection; "austeridad republicana" and budget discipline (5B.3); national production priority and rejection of strategic-sector privatisation (5B.4); national consultation mechanism (5B.7); "socialdemocracia pragmática" self-description relevant to 5B.1 and 5B.10.

**Exclusion rationale summary:** Chunks U0001–U0004, U0007–U0010 are dominated by political biography, electoral history, partisan opposition rhetoric, navigation metadata, or early career narrative. None contains a concrete named policy action, measured outcome, cost, distributional result, implementation finding, method, qualification, attribution fact, or contrary finding bearing on economic management quality. Topic overlap (poverty, corruption, energy) without policy specificity does not satisfy the evidence test.
